source_bank: existing 960 functional solutions per seed; no teachers retrained
objective: source-only actual masked child retraining utility; shared elite archive; no mask surrogate gradients
child: Adam lr.1 L2.01, identical fixed1400 updates and terminal weights for every source/validation/test candidate. Record empirical support/objective/query plateau flags; a cap is not a convergence claim.
solver_pilot: meta-validation only, baselines dense and uniform, grid lr .03/.1 and L2 .001/.01, cap1400, min500, plateau<=1% two4 windows three passes; select common config converged>=90% first then mean query
source_search: 12 initial whole masks/task; 2 feedback rounds of 8 GNN/FΜ proposals/task; child weights and episodes paired; record every mask and loss
outer: at most 3 stages of600 steps per model, early empirical fixed-noise loss plateau after300; hard time cap180s per fit; caps never called convergence
bank_representation: centroid-align source columns using full functional q; node mean/std of full187 features and edge q mean/std/mask frequency; input positions anchored, hidden nodes equivariant, explicit alignment prior
test: existing inspected task split is exploratory; no new test scores until solver, checkpoints and candidates frozen; query selection allowed on new task separate from test
report: plots including masks and effective signed weights with captions; own GPU workers terminate on finish
protocol_amendment_before_model_training: After validation-only pilot and independent review: all source/main fits use fixed1400 terminal steps; query never selects child checkpoints or stopping. LR/L2 pilot remains query-selected and fully archived.
quality_feature: Teacher quality channel zeroed before functional-bank pooling; bank itself previously source-query curated.
elite: Four distinct whole masks per source task; weights softmax(-sourcequeryBCE/.03); avoid duplicate elite labels.
single_proposals: Only bank+support context; terminal child weights trained on support only. Query searched variants explicitly separate.
fm_continuation_before_any_test: Final FM reached600-step cap in both seeds, loss still improving: one warm restart from best stage2 (same archive, new fixed-noise monitor, fresh Adam lr.0005, cap1200 or180sec). No new utility candidates or test use. Initial nonconverged stages retained.
fm_polish_before_any_test: 8100 passed775-step plateau in ~15s; 8102 still improved at1200 (~23s), so one final <=600-step polish lr.0000625 on same source elites, no new candidates/testlabels; preserve initial caps. Lower rate addresses stochastic optimizer fluctuations, not proof of optimum.
